strategicModel.primaryDomain: Office template library: users pick a DOCX or PPTX template, get their own copy and edit it in the browser.
strategicModel.classificationRationale: The brief scores template handling and copy isolation, so the catalog and the workspace are core. Editing office files is a solved problem, so the editor is bought (ONLYOFFICE) and kept behind an anti-corruption layer.

subdomains.name: Template Catalog
subdomains.description: Templates, categories and previews that users browse, search and preview.

subdomains.name: Document Workspace
subdomains.description: Documents users create from templates, edit and download. Copy isolation lives here.

subdomains.name: Document Editing
subdomains.description: In-browser editing of office files and preview rendering, supplied by ONLYOFFICE Document Server.

contexts.name: Template Catalog
contexts.description: The catalog holds every template and category. It serves the gallery, the preview and the template file that a document is copied from.
contexts.businessCapability: Browse, search, filter and preview templates of each kind. Add or update templates without changing the UI.

aggregates.name: Template
aggregates.description: A template is a ready-made DOCX or PPTX file that users copy. It holds the metadata, the current file and the previews. Its file is never rewritten.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: kind, current file, revision, thumbnail and previews.
invariants: The template kind matches the MIME type of its file.
A published template has a thumbnail and at least one preview.
A stored template file is never rewritten. A new revision gets a new storage key (D2: a template update creates a new revision).
The slug is unique within its kind.

fields.name: description
fields.description: One or two sentences shown on the gallery card.

fields.name: revision
constraints: increases by one on each update

fields.name: file
fields.description: The current revision's file in the read-only template store.

fields.name: previews
fields.description: One image per page (DOCX) or per slide (PPTX), in order.

lifecycle.description: An imported template is published at once. Archiving hides it from the gallery without touching existing documents (D4: an archived template leaves the gallery but its documents keep working).

transitions.description: The operator imports a new file for the template.
guards: The new file has the same kind as the template.
sideEffects: The gallery shows the new thumbnail and previews. Existing documents are unchanged.

guards: Only an operator archives a template, through the import command or the API.

transitions.description: The operator brings the template back.
guards: The template has a thumbnail and at least one preview.

aggregates.name: Category
aggregates.description: A category is a label that groups templates, such as Business or Education. One list serves both kinds (D3: categories are shared by both template kinds).
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: slug and name.

events.name: Template imported
events.description: A new template enters the catalog through the import command. The gallery shows it on the next load.

events.name: Template revised
events.description: An operator imports a new file for a template. Documents made from older revisions are unaffected.

events.name: Template archived
events.description: An operator retires a template. It leaves the gallery and cannot be used for new documents.

events.name: Template published
events.description: An archived template returns to the gallery.

useCases.name: Browse the gallery
useCases.description: The user sees the published templates of one kind and narrows them by search text and category.
steps: Open the DOCX or PPTX gallery.
Type a search or pick a category.
See matching templates, or an empty state with Clear filters.

useCases.name: Preview a template
useCases.description: The user opens a template and sees all its pages or slides before using it.

useCases.name: Import a template
useCases.description: An operator adds or updates a template from the template manifest. The catalog renders previews and publishes it.

rules.description: The gallery lists only published templates of the requested kind.
The catalog accepts only DOCX and PPTX files and checks the content, not only the extension.

contexts.name: Document Workspace
contexts.description: The workspace holds the documents users create from templates. It copies the template file, keeps each saved version and serves downloads.
contexts.businessCapability: Create an independent document from a template, edit it, list it under My documents and download it.

aggregates.name: Document
aggregates.description: A document is the user's own copy of a template. It holds its file, its origin and its current version. It never shares storage with a template.
aggregates.consistencyBoundary: Must be correct together: file, version and editor key.
invariants: The document file lives in the document store, never in the template store.
The document kind equals the kind of its source template.
Every saved version gets a new editor key.
The version increases by one on every saved version.

fields.name: origin
fields.description: Template id, revision and name at the moment of creation (D2: a template update creates a new revision).

lifecycle.description: A document is ready until someone opens it in the editor. Each saved version returns it to ready with a higher version.

transitions.description: The user opens the document in the integrated editor.
sideEffects: The editor loads the current version under the current editor key.
guards: The document exists and its file is readable in the document store.

transitions.description: The editor reports that an edited version is ready to store.
guards: The save callback is signed by the editor.
The callback names the document's current editor key.
sideEffects: The new file replaces the document's file. The version goes up by one and the editor key changes.

transitions.description: The editor reports that the session closed with no changes.
guards: The save callback is signed by the editor.

events.name: Document created
events.description: A user creates a document from a template. My documents shows it at once.

events.name: Document saved
events.description: The editor stores an edited version. The next open and download serve this version.

useCases.name: Use a template
useCases.description: The user picks a published template and gets a new document copied from it, then lands in the editor.
steps: The workspace copies the template file to the document store and checks the checksum.
The editor opens the new document.

useCases.name: Edit a document
useCases.description: The user changes the document in the integrated editor. Saved changes persist to that document only.

useCases.name: Download a document
useCases.description: The user downloads the current version as DOCX or PPTX.

useCases.name: List my documents
useCases.description: The user sees earlier documents and reopens or downloads any of them.

rules.description: Creating a document copies the template file to new storage. The template file is never opened for writing.
A document can be created only from a published template (D4: an archived template leaves the gallery but its documents keep working).
The workspace accepts a saved version only from a signed editor callback.

contexts.name: Editor Integration
contexts.description: Editor integration translates between the app and ONLYOFFICE Document Server. It builds the signed editor configuration, turns save callbacks into workspace commands and renders previews. The adapter conforms to the Document Server editor, callback and conversion APIs.
contexts.businessCapability: Edit DOCX and PPTX in the browser and render page or slide images, without ONLYOFFICE terms reaching the core contexts.

rules.description: Every editor configuration and every callback carries a JWT signed with the shared secret.
Callback status 2 becomes save_edited_version. Status 4 becomes close_without_changes. Other statuses are logged and ignored.

relations.description: The workspace asks the catalog for a published template's metadata and file stream when a user uses a template.
The workspace asks for an editor configuration and receives save callbacks translated into its own commands.
The catalog asks for page or slide images when it imports a template revision.

buildingBlocks.name: TemplateId
buildingBlocks.purpose: Identifies one template. Clients never pass file paths, only this id.

buildingBlocks.name: TemplateKind
buildingBlocks.purpose: The office format of a template or document. Each kind knows its MIME type, extension and editor type.
responsibilities: Map docx to word editor and pptx to slide editor.
Allow a new kind such as xlsx by adding one entry.

buildingBlocks.name: StoredFile
buildingBlocks.purpose: A file in storage: storage key, MIME type, size and sha256 checksum.
invariants: The checksum matches the stored bytes.

buildingBlocks.name: PreviewImage
buildingBlocks.purpose: One rendered page or slide image with its order and size.

buildingBlocks.name: TemplateImporter
buildingBlocks.purpose: Imports or revises templates from the template manifest.
responsibilities: Store the file under a new key.

buildingBlocks.name: TemplateGalleryView
buildingBlocks.purpose: Published templates of one kind filtered by search text and category, for the gallery.

buildingBlocks.name: TemplateSource
buildingBlocks.purpose: The catalog's interface for the workspace: get a published template and open its file for reading.

buildingBlocks.name: TemplateOrigin
buildingBlocks.purpose: A snapshot of the source template id, revision and name, taken at creation.

buildingBlocks.name: EditorKey
buildingBlocks.purpose: The cache key the editor uses for one document version.
invariants: It changes after every saved version.

buildingBlocks.name: DocumentFactory
buildingBlocks.purpose: Creates a document from a published template by copy-on-create.
responsibilities: Copy the template file into the document store.

buildingBlocks.name: MyDocumentsView
buildingBlocks.purpose: Documents newest first with title, kind, origin and last saved time.

buildingBlocks.name: FileStorage
buildingBlocks.purpose: Reads and writes files by storage key. The template store is read-only to the workspace.

buildingBlocks.name: EditorGateway
buildingBlocks.purpose: Builds an editor configuration for a document and delivers save callbacks as workspace commands.

buildingBlocks.name: PreviewRenderer
buildingBlocks.purpose: Renders page or slide images from a template file.

buildingBlocks.name: OnlyofficeAdapter
buildingBlocks.purpose: Implements EditorGateway and PreviewRenderer over ONLYOFFICE Document Server.
responsibilities: Call the conversion API for previews.

decisions.decision: The domain has three bounded contexts: Template Catalog (core), Document Workspace (core) and Editor Integration (generic, an anti-corruption layer over ONLYOFFICE).
decisions.rationale: Catalog and workspace carry the scored rules. The editor is bought.

decisions.decision: Updating a template creates a new revision with a new stored file. No template file is overwritten, and a document records the template id and revision it came from.
decisions.rationale: Keeps template immutability absolute and every document traceable.

decisions.decision: One category list serves both DOCX and PPTX templates.
decisions.rationale: Categories apply to both kinds, and one list keeps the manifest simple.

decisions.decision: An archived template leaves the gallery and cannot be used for new documents. Documents created from it keep opening, saving and downloading.

openQuestions.question: Are renaming and deleting a document in scope?
openQuestions.impact: Adds two commands and a terminal state to the Document lifecycle, and extends My documents.
